name: Kamimura Yuuki
source:
The main character.

He is a family-oriented young man who grew up with the love of his parents. He is a leader in his class and is often relied upon.

Surrounded by his close family and friends, he had a smooth sailing life. He was good at editing videos and uploaded clipped videos on YouTube.

After his father was hospitalized, he took on part-time jobs to help make ends meet and pay off his debts.

He was going to quit high school and work, but his parents stopped him and he is still attending the school.
